title: Reactor Runtime Production Dispatch
summary: Freeze the reactor-owned runtime seams and dispatch isolated workers for userspace-run shell, per-hart runtime loop, CoreInit timer/trap integration scouting, and AST return-to-user hook scouting.

write_sets.notes: Owns shared reactor facade/task-table edits, seam decisions, progress catch-up, final audit, and integration.
Own the reactor-local userspace-run request/result shell. Do not edit runtime.rs/task.rs/lib.rs; report any needed facade hooks to the coordinator.
Own the platform-independent per-hart loop result/step API over existing scheduler, timer, and dispatch state. Do not edit runtime.rs/lib.rs; report any needed facade hooks to the coordinator.
Read-only scout for CoreInit/HAL timer/trap integration. No code edits in the first pass.
Read-only scout for AST return-to-user hook shape across reactor, trap, ThreadRuntime, and signal policy.

steps.title: Freeze dispatch seam and worker write scopes
steps.notes: Serial prework defines the split: userspace-run and per-hart loop are implementation shards; CoreInit runtime loop and AST return-to-user are scout-only until trap/thread-runtime ownership is ready.

steps.title: Implement reactor-local userspace-run shell
steps.notes: Added a host-testable UserspaceRunSlot/UserspaceRunWait shell that resolves only on interesting traps; timer preemption records reactor-internal state without completing the wait. Coordinator kept full Reactor::request_userspace_run facade and ThreadRuntime/trap integration out of this pass.

steps.title: Implement platform-independent per-hart loop step API
steps.notes: Added tx_reactor::hart_loop with a bounded per-hart step API over timer advancement, wake dispatch, preemption markers, ready polling, and deadline reporting. WFI, timer programming, IPI ack/send, and trap mechanics remain outside tx-reactor.

steps.title: Scout CoreInit timer/trap runtime integration
steps.notes:
Scout recommends the next CoreInit

adapter over tx_reactor::hart_loop, binding TimeIf/SmpIf trap mechanics outside tx-reactor while preserving the current boot smoke contract.

steps.title: Scout AST return-to-user hook
steps.notes: Scout defines a policy-neutral userspace-entry AST checkpoint and leaves signal selection, ThreadPayload mutation, VM fault policy, and return_to_userspace with adjacent owners.

steps.title: Audit, integrate, and catch up progress
steps.notes: Coordinator accepted the two implementation shells, kept the two high-coupling runtime pieces as scouts, updated design/progress wording, and passed the final validation gates.

verification.notes: Passed after plan creation and after coordinator catch-up.
Passed after userspace-run and per-hart loop shards landed.
Final coordinator gate passed after implementation and progress catch-up.

risks: userspace-run crosses trap-frame return, ThreadRuntime payloads, VM, and AST policy; the first shard must stop at a reactor-local shell.
per-hart loop and userspace-run both need runtime.rs exports, so coordinator must audit overlap before integration.
CoreInit integration should remain scout-only until the reactor loop step API exists.
AST return-to-user cannot be fully implemented until ThreadRuntime and signal policy define the consumer.
blockers: Real return_to_userspace and saved-register trap-frame restore are still pending in the trap shell.
ThreadRuntime entities and signal delivery policy are not implemented.
